comments: Way easier than email. I like seeing the status.
Can we sign in with our normal company login? One more password is annoying.

Doesn't work great on my phone. I'm on the road a lot.
Can we attach photos from the phone? Easier to show a jammed label printer.

Single sign on would be great
Fine for me. Will Victor's requests still get priority?
Love the email notifications when it's updated. SSO?
